physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: Clockwise from True North (0=North, 90=East, 180=South, 270=West). sx=cos(alt)*sin(az), sy=cos(alt)*cos(az)
physics_and_implementation_audit.expected_definition: Standard navigation/meteorology azimuth (clockwise from True North)
physics_and_implementation_audit.recommended_action: Retain. Perfectly aligns with standard solar physics.

physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: Local Cartesian grid: +X = East, +Y = North, +Z = Upward elevation
physics_and_implementation_audit.expected_definition: Right-handed East-North-Up (ENU) Cartesian frame

physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: Rays traced from receptor points towards the sun vector (sx, sy, sz)
physics_and_implementation_audit.expected_definition: Vector from ground point pointing towards sun for line-of-sight visibility

physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: Origin placed at receptor center (x_pt, y_pt, z_ped=1.1m) with building footprint containment checks
physics_and_implementation_audit.expected_definition: Pedestrian height receptor (1.1m a.g.l.) with zero self-intersection

physics_and_implementation_audit.item: Grid-cell center versus grid-cell corner sampling
physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: Grid cell centers evaluated at (i + 0.5)*dx and (j + 0.5)*dy
physics_and_implementation_audit.expected_definition: Finite volume / cell-centered raster representation

physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: zmin = 0.0m to zmax = height; differential height slice for height edits delta_h = |h1 - h0|
physics_and_implementation_audit.expected_definition: Vertical building extrusion above flat ground level (z=0)

physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: Hemispherical multi-azimuth horizon elevation search for SVF; cardinal wall view factors
physics_and_implementation_audit.expected_definition: Standard Lindberg et al. (2008) multi-azimuth horizon scanning

physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: Equal azimuthal weighting (1/N) with cos^2(elev) solid-angle projection
physics_and_implementation_audit.expected_definition: Continuous azimuthal integration across upper hemisphere

physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: f_up = f_down = 0.06, f_north = f_south = f_east = f_west = 0.22 (sum = 1.0)
physics_and_implementation_audit.expected_definition: Rotationally symmetric standing human cylinder (Höppe 1992)

physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: a_k = 0.70 (shortwave absorptivity), a_l = 0.97 (longwave emissivity), Prata (1996) clear-sky air emissivity
physics_and_implementation_audit.expected_definition: Standard biometeorological human clothing/skin values and empirical clear-sky emissivity
physics_and_implementation_audit.recommended_action: Updated README documentation to correctly cite Prata (1996).

physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: Wall Ts = 305.15 K (32 C), Ground Ts = 308.15 K (35 C) under steady-state daytime conditions
physics_and_implementation_audit.expected_definition: Estimated diurnal surface temperatures in absence of coupled transient heat balance
physics_and_implementation_audit.recommended_action: Explicitly document as a physical limitation of single-timestep modeling.

physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: Ta (deg C), Tmrt (deg C), v10 (m/s), RH (%)
physics_and_implementation_audit.expected_definition: Celsius, Celsius, m/s, percent [0..100]

physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: Wind speed clamped to minimum 0.5 m/s; RH clamped to [0, 100]%

physics_and_implementation_audit.item: Handling of missing or invalid values
physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: Building interior cells masked with SVF=0, shadow=0, Tmrt computed safely with lower bound S_str >= 1.0
physics_and_implementation_audit.expected_definition: Finite numerical values across all grid receptors with zero NaN or Inf propagation

physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: Solar altitude threshold alpha < 5.0 deg triggers sound full fallback (is_fallback=True)
physics_and_implementation_audit.expected_definition: Safe threshold where shadow plume approaches infinite length

physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: Numerical verification slack threshold = 1e-6 K
physics_and_implementation_audit.expected_definition: Accommodate IEEE-754 double precision roundoff in trigonometric and power operations

physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: SHA-256 fingerprinting on scene JSON and weather data; verified across sequential edits in test_adv_10
physics_and_implementation_audit.expected_definition: Immediate invalidation of cached hashes upon any geometric mutation

physics_and_implementation_audit.item: Accumulation of error after approximate reuse
physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: Tested in test_adv_10: sequential edits track accumulated predicted bounds and preserve validity
physics_and_implementation_audit.expected_definition: Bounding error drift over multi-step editing sessions
physics_and_implementation_audit.recommended_action: Recommend re-grounding to full recompute after N consecutive approximate edits.

physics_and_implementation_audit.item: Whether every enabled radiation dependency is included in the certificate
physics_and_implementation_audit.current_implementation: Direct beam, diffuse sky, wall longwave, and atmospheric sky longwave all bounded via Minkowski plume and SVF decay
physics_and_implementation_audit.expected_definition: All modified radiative flux components must have closed-form conservative upper bounds
physics_and_implementation_audit.recommended_action: Fixed side direct beam factor from max(|sx|, |sy|) to (|sx| + |sy|) ensuring strict conservativeness.

external_solweig_audit.target_model: Official SOLWEIG / UMEP (Urban Multi-scale Environmental Predictor)
external_solweig_audit.host_platform: QGIS Python Plugin / Standalone UMEP Core

spatial_input_format.our_format: Discrete Vector 3D Primitives / Axis-Aligned Bounding Boxes rasterized onto 2D Grid
spatial_input_format.umep_format: 2D GeoTIFF raster Digital Surface Model (DSM) and Canopy Digital Elevation Model (CDEM)
spatial_input_format.status: Mismatch: Requires rasterization adapter from vector buildings to GeoTIFF DSM.

coordinate_conventions.our_format: Local Cartesian (u, v) in meters, flat terrain z=0
coordinate_conventions.umep_format: Projected CRS (e.g. UTM / EPSG:32633) with georeferenced raster headers
coordinate_conventions.status: Mismatch: Requires EPSG coordinate projection metadata in raster headers.

sky_discretization.our_format: Multi-azimuth horizon elevation angle search (16, 32, 64 rays)
sky_discretization.umep_format: 153-patch Tregenza sky discretization / Shadow casting algorithm (Lindberg et al., 2008)
sky_discretization.status: Conceptual match: Both use angular horizon elevation tracing.

meteorological_forcing.our_format: Single-timestep static Weather dataclass (Ta, RH, DNI, DHI, Wind)
meteorological_forcing.umep_format: Continuous tabular CSV (hourly/minutely) with global solar radiation and diurnal cycles
meteorological_forcing.status: Compatible: Can be evaluated at a single row matching our Weather parameters.

human_body_weighting.our_format: Standing rotationally symmetric cylinder (f_up=0.06, f_down=0.06, f_side=0.22)

compatibility_matrix.integration_status: External executable integration is not currently possible without installing QGIS and UMEP plugin dependencies in this lightweight Python environment. Analytical reference cases serve as independent ground truth.
